target/snapshot-pre.json and target/snapshot-post.json: the target workload and each upstream, read-only, before and after the load. The two files share this schema and differ in phase.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/target-snapshot.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `5b46cdad0e5c`.

## Top level

| Field         | Type                                                               | Required | Description     |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | --------------- |
| `phase`       | [snapshotPhase](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#snapshotphase) | Yes      |                 |
| `captured_at` | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)            | Yes      |                 |
| `workloads`   | array of [workload](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#workload)  | Yes      | at least 1 item |

## Definitions

### snapshotPhase

Type: `"pre"`, `"post"`

### workloadRole

Type: `"target"`, `"upstream"`

### resourceQuantities

Kubernetes resource quantities by resource name, for example cpu, memory, nvidia.com/gpu.

Type: map of `string`

### envVar

An environment variable. A redacted one carries no value: a run never stores a secret.

Type: `object` or `object`

### container

| Field                     | Type                                                                         | Required | Description                                                                           |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`                    | `string`                                                                     | Yes      |                                                                                       |
| `image`                   | `string`                                                                     | Yes      |                                                                                       |
| `image_digest`            | `string`                                                                     | No       | The resolved digest, from the pod's container status. pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$` |
| `args`                    | array of `string`                                                            | No       |                                                                                       |
| `env`                     | array of [envVar](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#envvar)                | No       |                                                                                       |
| `requests`                | [resourceQuantities](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#resourcequantities) | No       |                                                                                       |
| `limits`                  | [resourceQuantities](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#resourcequantities) | No       |                                                                                       |
| `restart_count`           | `integer`                                                                    | No       | ≥ 0                                                                                   |
| `last_termination_reason` | `string`                                                                     | No       | For example OOMKilled.                                                                |

### pod

| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------- |
| `name`       | `string`                                                            | Yes      |                 |
| `node`       | `string`                                                            | No       |                 |
| `containers` | array of [container](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#container) | Yes      | at least 1 item |

| --------- | --------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `desired` | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 0         |
| `ready`   | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 0         |

### node

Labels of a node the workload runs on (instance type, GPU model).

| Field    | Type            | Required | Description |
| -------- | --------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`   | `string`        | Yes      |             |
| `labels` | map of `string` | Yes      |             |

### hpaMetric

| Field    | Type     | Required | Description                           |
| -------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `type`   | `string` | Yes      |                                       |
| `name`   | `string` | Yes      |                                       |
| `target` | `string` | Yes      | Target value as Kubernetes prints it. |

### hpa

HorizontalPodAutoscaler of the workload. min\_replicas &lt;= max\_replicas is not expressible here and is a servtuner validate rule.

| Field              | Type                                                                | Required | Description |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `name`             | `string`                                                            | Yes      |             |
| `min_replicas`     | `integer`                                                           | Yes      | ≥ 0         |
| `max_replicas`     | `integer`                                                           | Yes      | ≥ 0         |
| `current_replicas` | `integer`                                                           | Yes      | ≥ 0         |
| `metrics`          | array of [hpaMetric](/reference/schemas/target-snapshot/#hpametric) | No       |             |

### targetInfo

What the workload reports about itself.

| Field          | Type              | Required | Description                                            |
| -------------- | ----------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `version`      | `string`          | No       | As the workload reports it, for example vLLM /version. |
| `models`       | array of `string` | No       | Model ids from /v1/models.                             |
| `cache_config` | map of `string`   | No       | vLLM cache\_config\_info labels.                       |

### hardwareProfile

Hardware the results are scoped to. Requires the accelerator (or none) and the node instance type or the CPU model; fields that cannot be read are omitted.

| Field                 | Type                 | Required | Description                                              |
| --------------------- | -------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hardware_profile_id` | `string`             | No       | Hash of the other fields.                                |
| `accelerator`         | `string`             | Yes      | GPU model, or none when the workload has no accelerator. |
| `gpu_count_per_pod`   | `integer`            | No       | ≥ 0                                                      |
| `gpu_memory_bytes`    | `integer`            | No       | ≥ 0                                                      |
| `gpu_interconnect`    | `"nvlink"`, `"pcie"` | No       |                                                          |
| `driver_version`      | `string`             | No       |                                                          |
| `cuda_version`        | `string`             | No       |                                                          |
| `node_instance_type`  | `string`             | No       | The cloud instance type, or local.                       |
| `cpu_model`           | `string`             | No       |                                                          |
| `cpu_cores`           | `integer`            | No       | ≥ 0                                                      |

Exactly which fields are allowed together is restricted further by the schema.
